messages:
nora (People Ops): Heads-up: we pushed a handbook language refresh focused on parental leave wording, remote-work eligibility, and localized GDPR notices for EU teams. Please review the summary + diff: https://go.redwood/hr/handbook-refresh-2026

ben (People Ops): TL;DR: three small changes — clarified parental leave pay schedule, added explicit remote-work eligibility criteria for shared office allowances, and localized data access notice for EU/UK. We need manager confirmations for their teams by 2026-06-01.

talia (Legal): Legal reviewed the changes; we added two optional phrasing variants for jurisdictions with different statutory notice periods. If you operate in a country with a conflicting law, pick the local variant and notify Legal.

omar (EM): Quick operational Q — do ICs in hiring process need to sign the new ack now or after offer?

nora (People Ops): New hires after 2026-05-10 should review the updated handbook as part of step 2 of onboarding. Existing employees just need to ack the handbook update via the HRIS confirmation flow. Contractors: only those with access to customer data need to ack.

ben (People Ops): We added a short FAQ doc for managers to copy into team channels. It covers common Qs: pay schedule, retroactive cases, and country-specific variants. Link: https://go.redwood/hr/handbook-faqs

translations-bot: Translation task created: 3 files (fr, de, ja). ETA 2026-05-18. Reviewers assigned: ben, talia.

omar (EM): Is there a CSV of team membership for bulk confirmations?

ben (People Ops): Yes  I'll drop per-manager CSVs to the shared folder by EOD today: `handbook_ack_exports/2012345678_manager_csvs.zip`.

talia (Legal): If managers choose a local variant, please add a one-line note in the "localization" column of the confirmation sheet so we have an audit trail.

nora (People Ops): Action items recap: 1) Managers review handbook diff and FAQ; 2) confirm their team ack in the sheet by 2026-06-01; 3) flag any country-variant selections to Legal; 4) People Ops will run a compliance export the week after the deadline.

omar (EM): Copyable blurb for team channel please?

ben (People Ops): Use this: `Update: Handbook language refresh for parental leave, remote-work eligibility, and EU data notices. Please review and ack by Jun 1. Managers  confirm in the shared sheet.`

nora (People Ops): Thanks all. We'll post in #announcements after translations land and drop the manager CSVs. Ping me or Ben for exceptions or urgent localization questions. :white_check_mark:
